name: How do I choose the right contractor for my basement finishing project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my basement finishing project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a contractor who provides direct, on-site supervision and has proven expertise in carpentry, drywall, and finish details. Many basement issues stem from poorly taped drywall joints, unlevel framing, or rushed tile work. Hiring an owner-operated general contractor ensures single-point accountability: the lead contractor oversees framing, drywall, and custom trim directly on site while managing licensed plumbing and electrical sub-trades. Verify local references, check BBB ratings, and ensure the contractor coordinates all technical trades without leaving you to manage subcontractors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an experienced, hands-on general contractor who personally supervises framing and finish trades on-site, coordinates licensed mechanical sub-trades, and holds solid BBB credentials.
